mapper.select: SELECT branch.branchid, branch.branchname, member.memberid, member.membername, vocaplan.vocaplanid, vocaplan.vocalevel, (SELECT codename FROM cmm_code WHERE code = vocaplan.vocalevel AND codetype = 'VOCALEVEL') vocalevel_name, vocaplan.dayofweek, vocaplan.passrate, vocaplan.targetcount, vocaplan.stopyn, DATE_FORMAT(vocaplan.regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') regdate FROM ttokssaemdb.vocaplan vocaplan, ttokssaemdb.branch branch, ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE vocaplan.branchid = branch.branchid AND vocaplan.memberid = member.memberid AND vocaplan.memberid = #{memberid}

mapper.select: SELECT branch.branchid, branch.branchname, member.memberid, member.membername, vocaplan.vocaplanid, vocaplan.vocalevel, (SELECT codename FROM cmm_code WHERE code = vocaplan.vocalevel AND codetype = 'VOCALEVEL') vocalevel_name, vocaplan.dayofweek, vocaplan.passrate, vocaplan.targetcount, vocaplan.stopyn, DATE_FORMAT(vocaplan.regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') regdate FROM ttokssaemdb.vocaplan vocaplan, ttokssaemdb.branch branch, ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE vocaplan.branchid = branch.branchid AND vocaplan.stopyn = 'N' AND vocaplan.memberid = member.memberid AND member.classyn = 'Y' AND (vocaplan.dayofweek & POW(2, ${dayofweek}) != 0)
